summary: Evidence of weakened EBITDA relative to debt suggests increased leverage risk, prompting a tightening of the Consolidated Total Net Leverage Ratio covenant. No other covenants require change based on available data.

clauses.rationale: Q1 2024 Adjusted EBITDA $11.7M and non‑vehicle net debt $203.4M imply leverage above 4.25x if annualized, indicating increased breach risk.
clauses.change: Lower the maximum allowed Consolidated Total Net Leverage Ratio threshold (make the covenant more restrictive)

evidence.quote: Adjusted EBITDA was $11.7 million, compared to $10.8 million or an improvement of 8.3%.
